preconditions.description: The number of vertices n must be between 2 and 200,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= ai <= n for ai in a)
preconditions.description: Each element ai in the input sequence must be an integer between 1 and n inclusive.

postconditions.description: The output must consist of exactly two lines: the minimum number of changes and a valid sequence.

postconditions.expression: min_changes == int(output_lines[0]) and all(1 <= int(x) <= n for x in output_lines[1].split())
postconditions.description: The first line must be the minimum number of changes (as an integer), and the second line must be a valid sequence of integers between 1 and n.
The sequence in the second line must be valid, meaning it represents a rooted tree with exactly one root (pr = r) and no cycles.

postconditions.expression: min_changes == sum(1 for i in range(n) if int(a[i]) != int(output_lines[1].split()[i]))
postconditions.description: The number of changes must equal the number of differing elements between the input and output sequences.

invariants.description: A sequence p is valid if it represents a rooted tree with exactly one root and no cycles.
